s1.desc: a snowy landscape of rolling white hills

spans.notes: Easter egg hunt of four side penguins (mint, purple, yellow, orange) under a pan right; no lead until Pax leaps in from the top left at f53. Pudgy toy figurines (a crowned penguin, an igloo, a goggled penguin in a red sweater) are held by the orange penguin and sit in the purple penguin's basket

spans.view: with snow-covered pine trees on the hills behind him

beats.text: Pax leaps in from the top left and dives belly-first toward the snow beside {x3} and {x2}
Pax lands on his belly and slides in between {x3} and {x2}, bumping into them
{x2} topples onto Pax's back while {x3} squeezes both eyes shut and stumbles back
Pax slides on his belly across the snow as {x2} tumbles over his back and falls away to the left
Pax keeps sliding on his belly with a striped Easter egg pushed along in front of his beak
Pax rolls over onto his back, grabbing the egg in his flippers
Pax lies on his back hugging the egg to his chest with a dreamy open-beaked smile
Pax rocks up from his back toward sitting, still clutching the egg

spans.notes: starts at f73, the first frame with no toy figurine left in view (the basket's last crown edge is at the left border at f72). The camera tracks Pax to the right the whole span (compare 86/98: every tree and hill edge doubled; tree band x0-0.30 vs f110: tx -12 at f112, -31 f116, -43 f120, settling about f122-124). {x3} is only a sliver at the left edge until f77. No overlay | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v23, by hand): absorbed [53,73) (figurines are props under the loose-figurines ruling)
11-frame rest between the pan and a push-in: tree band vs f124 scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 f125-134. Pax sits up holding the egg
fast push-in as Pax lifts the egg: scale 1.004 at f135, 1.057 f137, 1.170 f139, 1.218 f140 (vs f124); locked from f142. 7 frames, so too_short ranks before camera_move

spans.view: with snowy pine trees on the slope behind him

beats.text: Pax sits in the snow holding a striped Easter egg high in one flipper, his other flipper pressed to his cheek in delight
Pax lowers the egg and hugs it to his chest, smiling with his eyes shut
Pax opens his eyes and holds the egg still while a large shadow slides across the snow toward him from the right
Pax sits still clutching the egg as the shadow climbs up over him until his whole body is darkened
Pax sits in the shadow holding the egg and blinks with a wary look
Pax turns his head to the right and looks over his shoulder with wide, worried eyes
